test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Sahara Desert is located in which of the following continent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Africa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sahara Desert is located in Africa.
 
• It is the largest desert in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• All northern Africa is filled with this dessert.
 
• The total area of the Desert is somewhere about 3,320,000 square miles.
 
• The Desert expands and contracts, so the area of the Desert varies.
 
• In the west, the Desert is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean.
 
• The Atlas Mountains and the Mediterranean Sea border the Desert in the north.
 
• The Red Sea bounds the Mountain in the East.
 
• Atop the African shield, the Sahara sits.
 
• Denuded pre-Cambrian rocks make the African shield.
 
• Mesozoic deposits cover the Sahara Desert.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc05ab4d13a8a5240b638752504c1293f430ac9378f566a0000770cf3eed8fd5.png]
